prompt:
## A Very Big Win

A party wins 400 of the 543 seats in the Lok Sabha. That is a very big majority.

**Predict:** Can this party now do anything it wants?

options.text: Yes. With so many seats, no rule and no court can stop it.
No. Its power comes from the people, and the Constitution binds it.
Only if every other party in the House agrees to each decision.
